title: Ada bar Chavu
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Chullin 75b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.75b.12): he owned a ben pekua—an animal removed alive from its slaughtered mother's womb—on which a bear fell. He came before Rav Ashi, and the passage implies that he was a Torah scholar.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman’s Hebrew reads דובא, “bear.” The linked Bavli has דיבא, “wolf,” though the English displayed there also says “bear.” Ben pekua is the name for the animal.
[Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=212&lang=en) cites this episode and calls Ada a great scholar. Hyman infers his scholarly standing from the exchange with Rav Ashi.
